headline: Request to buy five Hackett Hill parcels received and filed; city will look at a future public sale.
summary: The tax collector's communication on back taxes was shared for information only, and all 2023 back taxes have been paid. Tech Freedom Village LLC asked to buy five city-owned parcels at Hackett Hill, and members asked questions about its plans. The request was received and filed.
decisions: Received and filed the request by Tech Freedom Village LLC to buy five city-owned parcels at Hackett Hill.
discussion: Hackett Hill offer price: Members asked what price the company would offer, and the company said it needed the committee's authority to proceed with an offer.

Site challenges: Members asked how the company would handle ledge and granite at the site. The company said site work is the biggest challenge and that more engineering and surveys are needed after negotiations start.
Due diligence time: The company estimated two to four months of due diligence, and members said the city would want its own due diligence.

Student and community access: Members asked how Manchester students and residents would get access to services, community space, and jobs. The company described hackathons, school and college partnerships, and a media lab.

decision_evidence.quote: so with that I will accept a motion to receive and file. Alderman Cauwoo seconded by Alderman Bonilla all those in favor aye aye

decision_titles: Tech Freedom Village request to buy five Hackett Hill parcels
